t: This was the Boydell Shakespeare Gallery, now a former art gallery. It was the first stage of a three-part project begun in November 1786 by John Boydell, an engraver and publisher, to foster a school of British history painting. He also planned an illustrated edition of Shakespeare's plays and a folio of prints. During the 1790s the gallery, which showed the original paintings, became the most popular part of the project. Boydell promoted the interests of artists as well as patrons, and his business prospered. He was Lord Mayor of London in 1790.
